receipts.source_basis: Fresh root full exact frozen physical-P16 source read in bounded windows.
concepts_actual_uses_and_mixup: AttachmentTarget combines a supporting parent entity, authored point ID, channel and capacity ordinal. Explicitly selected identity tuples omit channel intentionally: channel acceptance is checked against the actual catalog point and ParentRequirement; parent/point/capacity distinguishes a slot from ordering/requirement ordinal.

ReachableTarget occupied versus empty attachment is a meaningful closed distinction. Occupied selection projects its supporting slots, empty selection names a concrete free capacity; deterministic sort prioritizes explicit selection and then parent/point/capacity. Selected membership is verified before a whole multi-parent topology is returned.

AttachmentPoint/placement/occupancy identity and capacity/requirement/order retain distinct semantics even where this older P16 source uses String/u16. Reusing a catalog identity owner during connected migration is preferable to inventing independent wrappers. This file alone does not establish full incoming graph admission.
receipts.disposition: Retain meaningful identity/custody/authority/quantity/state distinctions and canonical projections; no new unique granularity issue established by these coherent local bodies. Catalog identity propagation and whole topology admission remain connected obligations, not silently cleared.

concepts_actual_uses_and_mixup: OccupancyRequirement is the canonical fit projection, distinct from stored topology occupancy and equipment catalog definition. Matching two character anchors gates authored_requirement; attachment conflicts use the actual parent/point/capacity predicate instead.

Candidate and current item/topology/occupancy triplets are semantically distinct correlation roles. Actual local loops pass matching records; arbitrary API mixing is not proved impossible by their common Rust types. The checked catalog requirement lookup preserves location/channel association; missing fit-zone falls back to the existing optional broad policy, not a new admitted exact-fit certificate.

The actor owner and ignored entity set bound conflict checks to current non-scene inventory; target_conflicts treats empty selection conservatively, while actual transfer caller remains next-role receiving work. Existing harness tests read complete22piece/neighbor/gauntlet behavior only, not executed.
